[FACT] User is looking to upgrade their 2015 Honda Civic to a newer model.  
[PREFERENCE] User is interested in information about the latest models of the Toyota Corolla, Hyundai Elantra, and Mazda3.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Toyota Corolla (2022 and newer) features a more aggressive exterior design, improved interior space, and enhanced safety features.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Toyota Corolla available trim levels: L, LE, SE, XLE, XSE, and Hybrid LE, XLE, and Limited.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Toyota Corolla powertrain options: 1.8L 4-cylinder engine (139 hp, 126 lb-ft torque), 2.0L 4-cylinder engine (169 hp, 151 lb-ft torque) on SE and XSE trims, Hybrid model combines 1.8L engine with electric motor (121 hp, 105 lb-ft torque).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Toyota Corolla features include Toyota Safety Sense 2.0 suite, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, 8-inch touchscreen, heated seats, and moonroof.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Toyota Corolla fuel economy: up to 31 mpg city, 40 mpg highway (1.8L engine), 53 mpg city, 52 mpg highway (Hybrid).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Hyundai Elantra (2022 and newer) features a more sculpted exterior, improved interior space, and updated technology.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Hyundai Elantra available trim levels: SE, SEL, N Line, and Limited.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Hyundai Elantra powertrain options: 2.0L 4-cylinder engine (147 hp, 132 lb-ft torque), 1.6L turbocharged 4-cylinder engine (201 hp, 195 lb-ft torque) on N Line and Limited trims.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Hyundai Elantra features include Hyundai SmartSense safety suite, 10.25-inch touchscreen, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, heated seats, and panoramic sunroof.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Hyundai Elantra fuel economy: up to 28 mpg city, 38 mpg highway (2.0L engine), 28 mpg city, 36 mpg highway (1.6L turbo engine).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Mazda3 (2022 and newer) features a more premium interior, improved driving dynamics, and updated technology.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Mazda3 available trim levels: 2.0, 2.5S, 2.5 Turbo, and Premium.
